# L&M Enterprises & SAGO Gas Bar

> Convenience store, in-store 19+ tobacco & vape counter, and full-service gas bar located on Tyendinaga Mohawk Territory in Deseronto, Ontario.

## Core Information
- **Business Name:** L&M Enterprises (Convenience Store) & SAGO Gas Bar (Full-Service Fuel Pumps)
- **Address:** 39–43 Dundas Street (Highway 49), Deseronto, Ontario, K0K 1X0, Canada
- **Telephone:** +1-613-396-2224
- **Operating Hours:** Open 7 days a week, 6:00 AM – 10:00 PM
- **Location & Highway Access:** On Dundas Street / Highway 49 (look for the black bear out front), 5 minutes south of Highway 401 via Exit 570 (Deseronto Rd) or Exit 566 (Marysville). Serving Tyendinaga Mohawk Territory, Deseronto, Napanee, Shannonville, Belleville, and Prince Edward County drivers.

## Fuel Services (SAGO Gas Bar — 39 Dundas St)
- **Service Style:** Full-service pumping — attendants pump your fuel at no extra charge.
- **Fuel Grades Available:**
  - Regular Unleaded Gasoline (87 octane)
  - Premium Gasoline (91 octane)
  - Clear Diesel (highway diesel for cars, pickups, SUVs, and commercial vehicles)
  - Dyed Diesel (tax-exempt off-road, agricultural, and equipment diesel)
- **Tax Exemption:** Point-of-sale fuel tax exemption available for eligible First Nations Status cardholders.
- **Posted Fuel Prices:** Current posted Regular, Premium, Clear Diesel, and Dyed Diesel pump prices and their recorded update timestamp are published at `https://www.lnmenterprises.ca/`. Prices can change; call `+1-613-396-2224` to confirm before a special trip.

## Store Offerings (L&M Enterprises — 43 Dundas St)
- **Convenience & Snacks:** Cold drinks, coffee, chips, candy, ice, and everyday road-trip essentials right beside the pumps.
- **In-Store Adult Categories (19+ with Valid ID Only, No Online Orders/Shipping):** Cigarettes, cigars, rolling tobacco, and disposable vapes/accessories sold in person at the Deseronto counter. Inventory rotates; call `+1-613-396-2224` to check specific items.
- **Payment Methods:** Cash, Debit, Visa, MasterCard. ATM available in store.
